subject: Hosted API: Uplift Sprint — commit increase & tier harmonization
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie@pulsecommerce.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Pulse Commerce AM <account@pulsecommerce.com>, Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@pulsecommerce.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Commit uplift request — Nov usage spike

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from our side — we saw a 3x spike in hosted API consumption across our recommendation and search flows during Black Friday week. Attached is a usage snapshot (nov). We'd like to propose a short-term uplift to our committed monthly tokens while we stabilize caching and batching on our side.

Goals:
- Move from current 1.2B monthly commit to 2.0B for the next 3 months
- Preserve current rateband pricing if possible, or get a clear band for the uplift period
- Add a 15% burst pocket to avoid throttles during peak windows

Can you share a proposed pricing and operational plan (canary rollout, soft-throttle behavior) and what you need on our side (PO, signed terms) to enable this quickly?

Thanks — happy to hop on a call today if helpful.

— Ellie
Senior Product Manager
Pulse Commerce

Attachment: pulsecommerce_usage_nov2026.csv
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@pulsecommerce.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T11:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commit uplift request — Nov usage spike

Hi Ellie — thanks for the snapshot and the clear ask.

Summary of what we can enable quickly:
- Short-term uplift: increase committed monthly tokens from 1.2B -> 2.0B for a 3-month pilot.
- Pricing: we can honor the current rateband for the first 1.8B, then a blended uplift rate for the extra 200M during the pilot. Detail in attached proposal.
- Burst pocket: provision a 15% burst buffer with soft-rate gating (graceband + token-level backpressure) — ops will autoscale GPU pools for predictable latency during peaks.
- Rollout: 2-week canary for 10% traffic, monitor latency & error rates; full cutover after success threshold (p95 latency increase < 20% and error delta < 0.5%).

What we need from Pulse Commerce:
1) PO referencing deal id PC-2026-11-UPLIFT or signed addendum to existing SOW.
2) Confirmation of a single billing contact and whether the uplift should be pro-rated this month.
3) Any security/compliance requirements for data residency (should remain on hosted).

Looping in Karthik for ops scheduling and Marissa for onboarding and migration playbook. If you confirm by Dec 10 we can target enabling the uplift the week of Dec 20.

Next steps:
- I attached a short proposal (redwood_proposal_uplift_20261129.xlsx) and a terms summary.
- If that looks good, Marissa will schedule a kickoff and Karthik will assign an ops window.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
+1 415 555 0132

Attachments: redwood_proposal_uplift_20261129.xlsx; terms_summary_v2.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T13:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commit uplift request — Nov usage spike

Vivek / team — quick ops note on execution and constraints:

- Capacity: We can allocate additional Dedicated-backed pools for the uplift but recommend starting on hosted burst capacity with policy routing to dedicated when p95 latency > 250ms for > 10m sustained.
- KV cache: Recommend Pulse enable prefix caching for recommendation calls to reduce token delta; Marissa can share the caching playbook.
- Rate limits & soft-throttle: We'll add a soft-throttle layer that returns 429 with X-Rate-Reset and an explanatory header for your clients. The 15% burst will be enforced via a transient quota per account, not per-route.
- Monitoring: We'll expose a per-route latency and cost dashboard in the Console and create a Pager duty escalation for any SLA breach.

Operational timeline (proposed):
1) Dec 1-7: Legal/PO finalization + provisioning request.
2) Dec 8-14: Canary prep + sim traffic test.
3) Dec 15-21: 10% canary -> 50% -> full roll over three step checks.

We should also include a rollback trigger (error rate > 1% or p95 > 400ms for > 15m).

Karthik
Director, Platform Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@pulsecommerce.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commit uplift request — kickoff & onboarding

Thanks all — happy to run the onboarding. Outline of the kickoff:
- 30m scoping call to confirm endpoints to be routed, caching hooks, and billing/proration preferences.
- Share our migration checklist (traffic split examples, canary metrics, rollback steps).
- Confirm contacts for incident comms and escalation (we prefer a single Slack channel + Pager duty rota).

Proposed times for kickoff: Dec 3: 10:00am PT or Dec 4: 2:00pm PT.

Also — small ask on terms: Pulse requested retention of current rateband for most of the uplift. Legal has a short addendum template that keeps existing tiers for the baseline and lists the pilot uplift pricing for the delta. If Pulse can sign that addendum, procurement can issue the PO immediately.

I'll upload the migration playbook to the Drive link once we lock a time.

— Marissa
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: migration_checklist.pdf (stub)
From: Ellie Park <ellie@pulsecommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@pulsecommerce.com>, Pulse Commerce AM <account@pulsecommerce.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commit uplift request — kickoff & onboarding

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 09:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks all — happy to run the onboarding. Outline of the kickoff:
> - 30m scoping call to confirm endpoints to be routed, caching hooks, and billing/proration preferences.

Sounds good. We confirm Dec 3 10:00am PT for the kickoff. We'll sign the addendum and route the PO to our procurement lead this week — target is PO in by Dec 10. We also request a 30-day pilot window where the uplift pricing applies retroactively to any overages during testing.

We appreciate the canary plan and rollback triggers — please include the X-Rate-Reset behavior in the integration notes so our client SDKs can surface friendly messages.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

— Ellie
Senior Product Manager
Pulse Commerce
